<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[1]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Monthly rates of return are geometrically linked to derive the returns reflected above.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[2]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Total return for periods less than twelve months have not been annualized.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[3]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Ratios have been annualized for periods of less than twelve months.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[4]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">The expense ratio is calculated by dividing the total expenses by the average Partners&#8217; Capital. The expense ratio attributable to an individual limited partners&#8217; account may vary based on tax-exempt status.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[5]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">The ratios of expenses and net investment income or loss to average Partners&#8217; Capital do not reflect the Aggregator&#8217;s proportionate share of income and expenses of underlying funds in which the Aggregator invests.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[6]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">The net investment income/(loss) ratio is calculated by dividing the net investment income/(loss) by the average monthly Partners&#8217; Capital.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[7]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Per unit data has been calculated using the average units method.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[8]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">The NAV and total returns have been calculated on net assets which include adjustments made in accordance with U.S. GAAP required at period end for financial reporting purposes.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[9]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Total return based on NAV per unit reflects the change in the NAV based on the effects of the performance of the Partnership during the period. Total return for periods less than 1 year have not been annualized.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[10]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Total return would have been lower had certain expenses not been waived and assumed by the Manager during periods of reimbursement.</td>
</tr>
<tr class="outerFootnote">
<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[11]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top">Ratios have been annualized for periods of less than twelve months, except for organizational costs, offering costs which are one time expenses and incentive fees which are not annualized. Ratios include allocations of investment income and expenses from the Aggregator.</td>
</tr>
